title: Transcriptomic-Based Identification of the Immuno-Oncogenic Signature of Cholangiocarcinoma for HLC-018 Multi-Target Therapy Exploration.
authors: Lawal, Bashir; Kuo, Yu-Cheng; Tang, Sung-Ling; Liu, Feng-Cheng; Wu, Alexander T H; Lin, Hung-Yun; Huang, Hsu-Shan
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于转录组识别胆管癌hub基因，并用分子对接探索小分子HLC-018与HMGA2的AT-hook DNA结合基序互作，但核心是肿瘤标志物与药物筛选，蛋白质-DNA互作仅作为次要环节，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法深度。
abstract: Cholangiocarcinomas (CHOLs), hepatobiliary malignancies, are characterized by high genetic heterogeneity, a rich tumor microenvironment, therapeutic resistance, difficulty diagnosing, and poor prognoses. Current knowledge of genetic alterations and known molecular markers for CHOL is insufficient, necessitating the need for further evaluation of the genome and RNA expression data in order to identify potential therapeutic targets, clarify the roles of these targets in the tumor microenvironment, and explore novel therapeutic drugs against the identified targets. Consequently, in our attempt to explore novel genetic markers associated with the carcinogenesis of CHOL, five genes (SNX15, ATP2A1, PDCD10, BET1, and HMGA2), collectively termed CHOL-hub genes, were identified via integration of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) from relatively large numbers of samples from CHOL GEO datasets. We further explored the biological functions of the CHOL-hub genes and found significant enrichment in several biological process and pathways associated with stem cell angiogenesis, cell proliferation, and cancer development, while the interaction network revealed high genetic interactions with a number of onco-functional genes. In addition, we established associations between the CHOL-hub genes and tumor progression, metastasis, tumor immune and immunosuppressive cell infiltration, dysfunctional T-cell phenotypes, poor prognoses, and therapeutic resistance in CHOL. Thus, we proposed that targeting CHOL-hub genes could be an ideal therapeutic approach for treating CHOLs, and we explored the potential of HLC-018, a novel benzamide-linked small molecule, using molecular docking of ligand-receptor interactions. To our delight, HLC-018 was well accommodated with high binding affinities to binding pockets of CHOL-hub genes; more importantly, we found specific interactions of HLC-018 with the conserved sequence of the AT-hook DNA-binding motif of HMGA2. Altogether, our study provides insights into the immune-oncogenic phenotypes of CHOL and provides valuable information for our ongoing experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 胆管癌（CHOL）作为肝胆系统恶性肿瘤，其特征包括高度遗传异质性、丰富的肿瘤微环境、治疗耐药性、诊断困难及预后不良。目前对CHOL的遗传变异和已知分子标志物的认识尚不充分，因此有必要进一步评估基因组和RNA表达数据，以识别潜在的治疗靶点，阐明这些靶点在肿瘤微环境中的作用，并探索针对已识别靶点的新型治疗药物。因此，在我们探索与CHOL癌变相关的新型遗传标志物的尝试中，通过整合来自CHOL GEO数据集中相对大量样本的差异表达基因（DEGs），识别出五个基因（SNX15、ATP2A1、PDCD10、BET1和HMGA2），统称为CHOL-hub基因。我们进一步探索了CHOL-hub基因的生物学功能，发现它们在多个与干细胞血管生成、细胞增殖和癌症发展相关的生物过程和通路中显著富集，而相互作用网络则揭示了与多种致癌功能基因的高度遗传相互作用。此外，我们建立了CHOL-hub基因与CHOL中肿瘤进展、转移、肿瘤免疫及免疫抑制细胞浸润、功能障碍性T细胞表型、不良预后及治疗耐药性之间的关联。因此，我们提出靶向CHOL-hub基因可能是治疗CHOL的理想方法，并利用配体-受体相互作用的分子对接技术，探索了新型苯甲酰胺连接小分子HLC-018的潜力。令人欣喜的是，HLC-018与CHOL-hub基因的结合口袋具有高结合亲和力，且适配良好；更重要的是，我们发现HLC-018与HMGA2的AT-hook DNA结合基序的保守序列存在特异性相互作用。总之，我们的研究为CHOL的免疫致癌表型提供了见解，并为正在进行的实验验证提供了宝贵信息。
